children: Archer Aviation reported that NYSE halted trading of its public warrants (ACHR WS) on September 1, 2026, under Section 802.01D and will suspend trading before the open on September 15, 2026, ahead of the warrants' expiration on September 16, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET. Any unexercised warrants will become void at expiration. The company's common stock continues to trade on the NYSE under ACHR.
